name: replay
invariant: A canonical SPHIST/1 envelope survives encode/decode, replays from its embedded initial option space to the same State, and has the same stable FNV-1a-64 digest in every implementation.
explanation: A terminal snapshot cannot establish provenance or portability. This fixture serializes the initial option space, certified rule set, and complete primitive history; decodes that envelope independently; replays it from a fresh State; and compares both the result and the canonical byte digest.
